title: Exclusive Time of Functions
description: Calculate the exclusive time of functions on a single-threaded CPU using log entries.
pseudocode:
1. stack = [], result = array(n).fill(0), prevTime = 0
2. for log in logs:
3.   id, type, time = parse(log)
4.   if type == 'start':
5.     if stack: result[stack.top()] += time - prevTime
6.     stack.push(id), prevTime = time
7.   else:
8.     result[stack.pop()] += time - prevTime + 1
9.     prevTime = time + 1

steps.note: Processing start of function 0 at time 0
Push function 0 to stack, update prevTime to 0
Processing start of function 1 at time 2
Push function 1 to stack, update prevTime to 2
Processing end of function 1 at time 5
Processing end of function 0 at time 6
Pop 0, calculate duration: 6 - 6 + 1 = 1, added to existing 2
